text:
Lina M.: Hey team, first-day checklist question. My Mac came with the company image but when I run `sudo fdesetup status` it says 'FileVault is Off'. MDM profile looks installed though. Should I wait for IT or try to enable FileVault myself? Also, do I need to complete the Security Awareness training before certain repo access is granted?

it-bot: Hi Lina  created ticket IT-4902 and notified eng-infra + security. Quick checks: `sudo fdesetup status` for macOS, `manage-bde -status C:\\` for Windows. Attach output to the ticket. If you prefer hands-on, reply with "urgent" and we'll expedite.

security-ops: Welcome Lina! Short answers: 1) Don't enable FileVault via iCloud or a personal account. If the MDM agent is present we can push the encryption enablement and escrow the key to our KMS. 2) Security training required by EOD day 3; some sensitive repo/team access is gated by training completion. 3) No opt-outs for phishing sims; they are part of mandatory awareness.

Lina M.: Thanks. Also a quick SSH question: our onboarding doc mentions adding a public key to my account. Can I reuse a personal ed25519 key?

Elaine C.: Prefer new work-only keys. Command: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "lina.m@redwood.com"` Then paste the public key to your profile. If you absolutely must reuse, we recommend rotating it first and not sharing passphrases.

Alex G.: Note for new engineers: we won't add you to the internal prod-admin GitHub team until you finish the security training and confirm YubiKey setup if you're on the admin list. Reach out if that blocks you.

Lina M.: One more  shipping/loaner question: do you ship YubiKeys to EU hires or is that handled locally? I can wait but want to know timeline.

Maya (People Ops): We ship EU hires via our EU partner warehouse for faster delivery. If you need a temporary software 2FA method, we can provide a time-limited emergency token. Reply with your desk address or mark "loaner" and we'll order a key this week.

security-ops: Also reminder: no production credentials on personal devices or external VMs. If you plan to spin up external test VMs, request a VPN exception and include IPs/ports and data classification. Review: https://intranet.redwood/security/device-and-vpn (internal).

Lina M.: Attaching `fdesetup` output to IT-4902 now. I'll generate a new SSH key and complete the training. Please mark YubiKey = loaner and ship to: 12 Rue Example, 75001 Paris.

it-bot: IT-4902 updated: assigned to @Elaine C. Estimated SLA 4 hours.

Elaine C.: Got it, Lina. We'll push the FileVault enable and escrow the key. YubiKey loaner order placed. You'll get training invite from trainings@redwood; ping @Maya if it doesn't arrive.

Alex G.: Great  once training shows green, I'll add you to the onboarding teams. Welcome aboard!

Maya (People Ops): (reacted :tada:)
